test_title: PYST 51: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 04 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Infrastructure development is essential for sustaining high growth and reducing regional disparities. Which of the following sectors is NOT typically included in the core infrastructure sectors in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tourism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Core infrastructure sectors in India are primarily those sectors that have a significant impact on the overall economy and are critical for its functioning.
 
• The core infrastructure sectors in India include **coal, crude oil, natural gas, refinery products, fertilizers, steel, cement, and electricity**.
 
• **Tourism** is not classified as a core infrastructure sector in India. While it contributes significantly to the economy, it is not categorized as a core sector due to its nature and dependence on services.
 
• Core sectors typically involve industries that are capital-intensive, resource-based, and foundational to the industrial and economic development of a nation.
 
• The performance of the core sectors is measured using the Index of Eight Core Industries (ICI), which is a key indicator of economic activity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cement**

 
 
• Cement is one of the core industries in India and plays a pivotal role in the infrastructure and construction sectors.
 
• India is the second-largest producer of cement globally, with the industry contributing significantly to GDP growth.
 
• It is essential for the development of roads, bridges, dams, and buildings.
 
 
 
• **Electricity**
 
 
• Electricity is a critical component of India's core infrastructure sectors and is a driving force behind industrial and economic growth.
 
• The power sector in India includes thermal, hydro, nuclear, and renewable energy sources.
 
• The availability and reliability of electricity are essential for industrial operations and improving the quality of life for citizens.
 
 
 
• **Iron and Steel**
 
 
• Iron and steel are vital core industries in India, forming the backbone of industrial growth.
 
• These materials are extensively used in construction, automobiles, infrastructure, and manufacturing industries.
 
• India is among the largest producers of crude steel in the world, and the industry plays a significant role in economic development.
